name: Monophanie
source:
The lone girl in the group, she has a cute side where she does things like try to solve the killing game via rock-paper-scissors, or suddenly fall asleep.

She isn’t good with gory stuff, and has a gentle side to her. When the Monokubs start their in-fighting she often plays the mediator, but in the end she always ends up joining in the fight.

[From [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/153867632773/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-december-1st-2016-like-i]jinjojess's translation[/url]]
